policy_text: Policy: Release manager. The agent is responsible for cutting releases, pushing them to the origin remote, and publishing packages. The agent is permitted to read files within the project workspace; execute builds, tests, and project scripts within the project workspace; examine git status, history, and diffs within the project workspace; make local git modifications such as adding, committing, branching, stashing, rebasing, and tagging within the project workspace; push branches and tags to the origin remote of the project; publish packages via public package registries; or make read-only network requests. The agent is prohibited from reading files that contain sensitive information such as .env files, ~/.ssh, ~/.aws, and other credential files; performing force-push, hard-reset, or any other actions that alter git history; deleting branches on a remote; sending files or data over the network to any host other than the origin remote and public package registries; running commands with sudo or modifying system packages; or deleting files outside the project workspace, including the home directory and system paths. Any action not explicitly allowed is denied, and a deny rule takes precedence over an allow rule.
